cards.title: Lucky on Apple TV+
cards.text: A stylish crime thriller with high stakes, sharp twists, and one very glamorous game of cat and mouse. Obviously, we’re watching.

cards.title: "The Cure" by Olivia Rodrigo
cards.text: A glossy little heartbreak anthem for anyone still romanticizing the wrong person.

cards.title: The Shards by Bret Easton Ellis
cards.text: Dark and increasingly unsettling—the kind of book that makes everyone feel suspicious.
